shared_elements: low-relief carved human figures shown in profile
procession/registered composition with figures facing right or toward a central element
animals rendered in profile (rams in A; possibly small offering/animal forms in B)
justification: Both are shallow relief surfaces showing profile human figures in a register bounded by a groundline, and both include figures who face and interact with something in front of them, which is a very generic correspondence. A depicts a naturalistic procession of bearded men leading horned rams with detailed fleece and curled horns, while B shows a rounded-topped panel with two schematic figures flanking a central column of small sign-like marks under an arched winged/floral canopy — different subject, different framing, and no shared specific motif.
